title: the seven workspace packages type-check
notes: with the pinned native compiler instead of whatever global `tsc` the
result: their `type-check` (and the plugin's declaration build) called a bare `tsc`, but `@typescript/typescript6` ships only `tsc6`, so it resolved to Homebrew's global TS 7.0.2 locally and to the runner image's global on CI, unpinned. Each package now declares `@typescript/native` (`npm:typescript@^7.0.2`) and calls `node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc`, the layout in `docs/typescript-7-migration.md`; `typescript` stays the 6.0.2 alias because TS 7.0 has no API and typescript-eslint allows `<6.1.0`.
evidence: `pnpm run check:ci` exit 0; an injected `string` to `number` assignment in gate-kit fails `type-check` with TS2322.
